records.body:
Activate the existing eligible renderer in Linux release builds with
fixed bounded policy and a trusted installed sibling. Keep approval,
audit, execution and input authority in Host and preserve inline fallback.
Install the worker beside Shell and Core in the RPM.

Keep a damaged handoff display lease until its native prompt flushes.
Defer a second physical failure during prompt recovery, retain input
Hold and retry the original PS1 without another user input. Do not
repeat the approved effect or HostExecutedResult.

Verify release processes and fault controls with the existing real
Core/PTY fixtures. Final dual-architecture installed/provider package
acceptance and explicit terminal takeback remain separate.

Fixes: 4a4961e41917 ("feat(cosh-ng): [shell] isolate approval UI")
